caption:
A larger-than-expected tax bill landing at a tight time is genuinely stressful, but it's also a well-understood situation with specialist finance built specifically to address it.

The key is acting before the due date rather than after — both to avoid compounding ATO interest and penalties, and because more finance options tend to be available before a debt becomes overdue.
